verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional webhooks report hard-bounce, soft-bounce, spam-complaint, reject and unsub events per message (mailchimp-docs-18), and Marketing campaign reports include click/open tracking (mailchimp-docs-21/22), giving some per-send deliverability signal. However there is no documented dashboard surfacing blocklist status or bounce/complaint rates per campaign, nor any described 'actionable guidance' feature when deliverability degrades; community reports instead describe opaque account suspensions after a single spam complaint with no proactive guidance (mailchimp-comm-5, mailchimp-comm-6) and poor sender reputation on lower tiers (mailchimp-comm-12). Missing for 10: a unified per-send bounce/complaint/blocklist report in the marketing UI, explicit blocklist monitoring, and documented proactive remediation guidance for marketers.
